# Boltech Group

> AI agents that automate processes, serve customers and organise the work. Start with a solution ready to configure, or build one to measure.

Site overview for assistants and answer engines. All copy is our own; prices are references.

## Product
- [Fewer tasks. More results.](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/): AI agents that automate processes, serve customers and organise the work. Start with a solution ready to configure, or build one to measure. Request a proposal.
- [Three ways to start](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/precios/): Three ways to start. Reference prices, not final offers. Contracting is subject to an approved quote, taxes and terms.
- [Clear scope, agreed integrations, supervised implementation](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/confianza/): Clear scope, agreed integrations, supervised implementation
- [From idea to agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/como-empezamos/): From idea to agent Tell us what you need: you pick a specialty and the tasks to solve.

## Specialties
- [Sales](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/ventas/): Every opportunity with its next step, without depending on someone remembering.
- [Customer service](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/servicio-al-cliente/): Every request reaches someone who can resolve it, on the first assignment.
- [Marketing](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/mercadeo/): Material that comes from the offer and the context, not from a blank draft.
- [Finance](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/finanzas/): Numbers arrive ordered and with their source, not on a loose sheet.
- [Logistics](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/logistica/): The state of a shipment is known before the customer asks.
- [Chemistry, Pharmacy and Registrations](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/especialidades/quimica-farmacia-registros/): Files are checked against the applicable rule, not against someone's memory.

## Agents
- [Sales Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-ventas/): Every opportunity with its next step, without depending on someone remembering. No follow-up leaves without an owner and a date, on every run.
- [Customer Service Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-servicio-cliente/): Every request reaches someone who can resolve it, on the first assignment. Misclassified requests are returned and feed the rule, on every run.
- [Marketing Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-mercadeo/): Material that comes from the offer and the context, not from a blank draft. No piece is delivered without human review, on every run.
- [Finance Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-finanzas/): Numbers arrive ordered and with their source, not on a loose sheet. No record is posted without its source document, on every run.
- [Logistics Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-logistica/): The state of a shipment is known before the customer asks. No alert is sent without the source that supports it, on every run.
- [Chemistry, Pharmacy and Registrations Agent](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/agentes/agente-registros/): Files are checked against the applicable rule, not against someone's memory. No file is declared complete without the requirement list verified, on every run.

## Comparisons
- [Accompanied service or platform](https://boltech-group.vercel.app/en/vs/servicio-o-plataforma/): There is no single answer: it depends on who will build, maintain and answer for the flow.

## Declared limits
- Published prices are references, not final offers.
- Contracting is subject to an approved quote, taxes and terms.
- External integrations require authorisation and certification.
- There is no 24/7 support.
